Cocktail Meatballs
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 7:17pm

Ingredients




1 pound hamburger
cup bread crumbs
cup onions minced
cup milk
1 egg
1 tablespoon parsley
teaspoon pepper
teaspoon worcestershire sauce
12 ounces chili sauce (heinz)
10 ounces grape jelly

Preparation

1 Mix first eight ingredients and shape into one inch balls. Use a 13 by 9 pan and place one inch of water in it. Place meatballs in pan and bake at 350 for 45-60 minutes. Mix chili sauce and jelly and heat in a sauce pan on thestove until they melt. Add meatballs to the sauce and heat about thirty minutes , stir while heating sauce and meatballs
